trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. There is no separate task: it is the reward for finishing the list. Work the roadmap in order — story, then activities, then collectibles, then the clean-up — and the platinum lands last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players will earn. No special requirement — just play the opening through to its end.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story only: keep playing the main story and the trophy unlocks at the end of the chapter. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — finishing the chapter is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: finish the chapter's story missions in order and it unlocks at the end. The title is a joke about the chapter's events; the trophy itself only asks for the chapter to be done.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Finish the chapter's story missions in order. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — the trophy follows the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish the chapter's story missions in order. The last chapter trophy before the final mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish the story's last mission and this gold trophy unlocks. It is the last story trophy; after it, only the open-world, activity and collectible trophies remain.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. A named story mission, so earn it when the mission comes up. The description names no location or step beyond the mission itself, so there is no route to give — just play the mission when it appears.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission — earn it during the mission. Mission replay has not been confirmed, so do not count on coming back to it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A named story mission, so earn it when it comes up. The description gives no step beyond the mission name.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission — earn it during the mission. Mission replay has not been confirmed, so do not count on coming back to it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A named story mission, so earn it when it comes up. The description gives no step beyond the mission name.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission — earn it during the mission. Mission replay has not been confirmed, so do not count on coming back to it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A named story mission, so earn it when it comes up. The description gives no step beyond the mission name.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission — earn it during the mission. Mission replay has not been confirmed, so do not count on coming back to it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. VCIA is the airport (Vice City International), so expect this one at the airport — but the description gives no step beyond the mission name.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission — earn it during the mission. Mission replay has not been confirmed, so do not count on coming back to it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission, so earn it when it comes up. The description gives no step beyond the mission name.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission — earn it during the mission. Mission replay has not been confirmed, so do not count on coming back to it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The game's completion counter — PSN tracks it as 0/100. Everything counts toward it: story, activities, collectibles and the rest. This is the last trophy before the platinum for most players; check the roadmap's final phase for what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. PSN tracks 0/250. Stunts are jumps and air time in vehicles — the count is cumulative across the whole game, so it builds up naturally while driving fast and using ramps. No single location is named in the description, so there is no shortcut to cite yet.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. PSN tracks 0/9 — nine activity types. Play one of each: races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, drone races and whatever else the game counts. The nine types are not listed in the description, so tick them off as you find them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. PSN tracks 0/42 — 42 challenges. Find the shooting ranges and score gold on every challenge. The description does not say where the ranges are or how many challenges each one holds, so no route can be given yet — work through the ranges one at a time and use the counter here to track them.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. PSN tracks 0/14 — 14 locations. Win one drone race at each of the 14 spots. The locations are not named in the description, so they have to be found in the world first.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PSN tracks 0/20. Race in 20 distinct events — repeats of the same race do not count twice. Any race type counts; the description does not list them.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a character you fish against; win a fishing challenge against him. The description does not say where or when the challenge happens, so watch for Cal while fishing.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine and finish one game on it. Any arcade game counts; the description names none.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. A character strand: finish Andy's last mission. Named-mission trophy — earn it when it comes up, since it may not come back.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission — the final mission for Andy. Earn it when it comes up; mission replay has not been confirmed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. A character strand: finish Kenton's last mission. Named-mission trophy — earn it when it comes up, since it may not come back.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission — the final mission for Kenton. Earn it when it comes up; mission replay has not been confirmed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. A character strand: finish Billy's last mission. Named-mission trophy — earn it when it comes up, since it may not come back.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission — the final mission for Billy. Earn it when it comes up; mission replay has not been confirmed.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. PSN tracks 0/8. Find the stranger missions scattered around the map and finish eight full strands. The strangers are not named in the description, so look for their markers while exploring.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. A character strand: finish Randy's last mission. Named-mission trophy — earn it when it comes up, since it may not come back.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission — the final mission for Randy. Earn it when it comes up; mission replay has not been confirmed.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. A character strand: finish Tyrone's last mission. Named-mission trophy — earn it when it comes up, since it may not come back.
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission — the final mission for Tyrone. Earn it when it comes up; mission replay has not been confirmed.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. PSN tracks 0/18 — 18 meditation spots. Find all 18 and meditate at each. The spots are not listed in the description, so they have to be found while exploring the map.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret asks for one specific animal; hunt it for him. The animal is not named in the description, so the exact target is not pinned down yet.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. PSN tracks 0/3. Collect cards around Leonida and finish three full sets. The cards' locations are not in the description, so this is a hunt across the map.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. PSN tracks 0/100. 'WAiNK It' is a photo or tag activity at 100 spots across the map. The spots are not listed in the description, so this is an exploration grind — use the counter here to track it.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. PSN tracks 0/50. The game has 50 challenges of various kinds; finish all of them. The challenge list is not in the description, so work through whatever challenges the game shows you.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then lose the cops and escape. The description does not say where to do it — any open stretch of road works once the heat is on.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between them. Plan a route past three shops before you start.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. PSN tracks 0/100. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles; each new one counts. Keep trying new vehicles rather than the same ones, and use the counter here to track them.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus (the game's slow-mo aim mode) and take down five enemies before it ends. Crowded fights are the place to try it; the description names no location.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is the airport — leave it in a way the game did not schedule. The description gives no step beyond the airport, so the exact trigger is not pinned down yet.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description is a joke line: Rhinos are the tanks, so this involves a Rhino tank and heat. No place or step is given in the description, so no exact method can be cited yet.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Pick a jewelry store, get in and out without any detection. Stealth matters more than speed; the description names no specific store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. PSN tracks 0/5. Rob five bank vaults and get away each time. The vaults are not listed in the description, so find them as you play.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck, rob it and escape. Trucks spawn in the world; the description gives no fixed spot.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PSN tracks 0/52 — 52 areas or districts. Visit every part of the map. The 52 areas are not listed in the description, so explore until the count stops rising.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. PSN tracks 0/9 — nine gangs. Rob one illegal operation per gang. The gangs and their operations are not named in the description.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. The bar is not named, but the beach is — this is one of the few trophies whose place is in its description.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through a vehicle showroom's front in style. Any showroom counts; the description names none.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish the follow-through. The alley is named — Kolt & Associates — which is the place to look for.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is a riddle, not a set of steps: it hints at a partnership activity done well. No place or step can be cited from it yet.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks 0/500 choices. Story choices count toward this; the description suggests decisions matter. It is flagged missable because a choice can lock to one playthrough — think before you pick at story choices. The 500 target is PSN's count, not a count of story missions.
trophies.missableNote: A story choice — the description says choices were made. A choice can lock to one playthrough, so decide carefully at story choices.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description is a joke line with no place or step. The trigger is not pinned down by any source yet — most likely a retry of something that failed once, but that is a guess, not a fact.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Another riddle line: something strange happens in the world and this pops. No place or step can be cited from the description, so watch for strange events while playing.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, knock bowling pins over with a melee attack. The bowling alley area is the natural place to try it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. PSN tracks $0/$250,000. Launder marked bills through contacts until $250,000 is clean. This is a long economy grind — it belongs in the final phase, after the story money is flowing.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. PSN tracks $0/$100,000. Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops. Big purchases count fastest; it pairs naturally with buying garages and vehicles.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. PSN tracks 0/8 — eight garage properties. Buy all eight. The properties are not listed in the description, so find them for sale around Leonida.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. PSN tracks 0/10. Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Any ten vehicles count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
